about: WORLD TWO [the best of both maps] (rule 243(b)3 and (b)4, Paolo 10/26: 'there are supposed to be bosses in this game where you're able to alter the map and what's going on in the world around you'). One row per act-one boss, in HIS ladder's order (records/BOHEMIA_THE_BOSS_LADDER_v7_8_7_26.md, engine/bohemia_ladder_data.js): where his place is (a district kind of the valley; the boss stands at the street block nearest it), the sign that marks him on the map (Valheim's runestone: a tag on a wall, a flyer, the radio, a man in a bar), and what changes on the map when he falls. EVERY ROW IS draft:true, HIS TO CHANGE: the districts, the signs' words and the changes are WORLD TWO's first attempt (rule 205: a default, named, his to kill). The ladder is a pool to cut from (its own words); DYNASTY owns the order (VAMILY NOTE 10/26), and a row it moves is moved here. A modder edits this file; nothing in code names a boss.

changes_known.lights: the lights come back on: his district's windows lit on the map, night and day (the painting under them is RUN's and unchanged)
changes_known.place: a place appears on the map where he stood, named (words draft)
changes_known.wall: a wall comes down: the nearest block between two streets near him opens, and the map's walk goes through it
changes_known.reveal: the map opens: every town shows through the static (THE SURVEYOR holds the last complete map)
changes_known.holds: who holds what shifts: the nearest home base changes hands by 'boss', one of the four ways (rule 43, his words 'raid, contract, boss verb, deal'), in WORLD's ledger (engine/bohemia_homebases.js)

fight.note: a boss is the biggest job's band (partyMath at three skulls) through the map's one door; COMBAT dresses the man himself (NOTE). WORLD TWO's default, TUNING's number.

sign.says: A flyer on the wall: HOT FOOD. ASK FOR THE POT.

bosses.feed: The kitchen on {district} is cooking again. Line around the block.

sign.says: Sprayed on a pipe: THE TAP SAYS WHO DRINKS.

bosses.feed: Nobody owns the pipe on {district} today. Fill your jugs.

sign.says: The radio: clean water, if you can get past THE FILTER.

bosses.feed: Clean water at {district}. Boil it anyway, mija.

sign.says: Burned into a door: WARM IS THE BURN'S.

bosses.feed: Fires on {district} all night and nobody is charging for them.

sign.says: A man at the bar: the Surveyor has the last real map. He sells pieces.

bosses.feed: Somebody copied the last real map of the valley. Every town is on it.

sign.says: A flyer: THE HOIST WORKS. THE CLIMB DECIDES WHO GOES UP.

bosses.feed: Lights on the top floors of {district}. First time in years.

sign.says: Scratched on a padlock: EVERY LOCK IS THE LOCKSMITH'S.

bosses.feed: The doors on {district} stand open. Nobody knows who has the keys now.

sign.says: The radio, then a bang: THE CHARGE is selling holes in walls.

bosses.feed: There is a hole in the wall on {district}. A new way through.

sign.says: A man at the bar: the Machinist welds pipe into guns.

bosses.feed: Pipe guns for trade on {district}. Crude. Yours.

sign.says: A flyer: SCRAP IN, ARMOUR OUT. THE PLATE.

bosses.feed: The press on {district} is running. Scrap in, armour out.
A dentist chair on {district}. Bring your own whiskey.

sign.says: Sprayed over an eye chart: THE LENS SEES YOU.

bosses.feed: Glasses ground to order on {district}. Read the small print again.

sign.says: A flyer: THE CHAIR, THE BLADE, THE BLEACH.

bosses.feed: Fresh fades on {district}. The bleach is real.

sign.says: Tattooed on a wall: THE INK KNOWS YOUR NAME.

bosses.feed: Ink on {district}. Mark yourself, everybody reads it.

sign.says: A man at the bar: the last kennel. THE DOGS.

bosses.feed: Pups at the kennel on {district}. They bite. Good.

sign.says: The radio: the last clinic is open, if THE WARD lets you in.

bosses.feed: The clinic on {district} has its lights on. Bring the hurt.

sign.says: Sprayed on a gutter: THE RAIN IS THE CISTERN'S.

bosses.feed: Rain off the roofs on {district}. Nobody to ask.

sign.says: A man at the bar: the last forge still lights. THE SMITH.

bosses.feed: The forge on {district} is lit. You can hear it from the road.

sign.says: The radio, a woman: every birth in the valley goes through THE MIDWIFE.

bosses.feed: A baby on {district} tonight. Everybody heard it.

how_known.fight: the default: arriving at his place is the fight (the meet card first, ENGAGE or FALL BACK); he falls when every one of theirs is down
how_known.meet: arriving at the place is enough (a boss who is a person to reach, never a fight: THE MIDWIFE)

district_note: Each list is tried in its order: the nearest block of the first kind 8 to 30 blocks from the sign, reachable, never within 3 of a town; then the next kind; then any street 10 to 20 blocks out (the state says fallback). Kinds read off the valley the game rolls (om.at(x, y).district, measured 10/26: 75 kinds, suburb 2,582 blocks to quarry 1).
